question: Who co-invented the device called Cyclotron in 1934 along with Ernest Lawrence to investigate the nuclear structure?
solution:
The correct answer is __**MS Livingston**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **A cyclotron** is a type of particle accelerator in which charged particles accelerate outwards from the center along a spiral path.
 
• It is based on the fact that the electric field accelerates charged particles and the magnetic field keeps it revolving in circular orbits of constant frequency.
 
• Ernest Lawrence and MS
